options.label: IBM Plex: engineered precision
options.rationale: Plex Sans with Plex Mono suits a technical, number-heavy talk with clear digits and a rigorous tone.

options.label: Serif headings, scholarly paper
options.rationale: A book-like serif heading echoes the arXiv paper and math derivations while a neutral sans keeps tables legible.

options.label: Space Grotesk: modern ML lab

options.label: Mono headings: code and proof
options.rationale: Monospaced headings evoke model output and step-by-step derivations, paired with a highly legible sans body.
